title: Two-motor duty alternation
goal: An operator can see which motor is lead and how reset transfers the next duty assignment.

rubric.must: Separate set coils labelled LeadA and LeadB are visibly driven by reset paths using the opposite lead-selector contact.
The MotorA rung contains LeadA and the MotorB rung contains LeadB, each with StartDemand.
ResetPB with LeadA visibly sets LeadB and resets LeadA on adjacent transfer rungs.
ResetPB with LeadB visibly sets LeadA and resets LeadB on adjacent transfer rungs.
MotorAOverload and MotorBOverload normally closed contacts are visible on their respective motor rungs.
MotorALamp and MotorBLamp coils are visibly driven from their respective motor contacts.

ideal.notes: Independently hand-composed reference after visual-eval/exemplars/ladder/ideal.svg (sha256 72319743d0eb). Vision-reviewed rendered SVG against source and exemplar, including labels, connections and symbol placement. Measured spacious rung bands and consistent AB contact, coil and reset-bracket symbols. All rungs and branch membership preserved. PROVISIONAL: scan-ordered set/reset rungs can transfer A to B and immediately B to A on the same ResetPB scan; no initial lead is declared.
